tier1.text: Each stylohyoid pulls up and back on the hyoid bone, a small U-shaped bone in the upper neck. The stylohyoid also lifts the larynx, or voice box. The facial nerve, which makes the muscles of the face contract, sends a branch to the stylohyoid.

quotes.quote: The stylohyoid is a pharyngeal arch II muscle that participates in oral/pharygeal behaviors and is innervated by the stylohoid branch of the facial nerve and attaches to the stylohyal and the non-stylohyal part of the hyoid apparatus.
facial nerve: seventh cranial nerve; responsible for contraction of the facial muscles and for part of the sense of taste, as well as causing saliva production
